# CANDIDATE: OVERNIGHT_GAP_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
Large overnight gaps in SPY tend to fill within the first 30 minutes, providing a long entry when price retraces to fill at least 50% of the gap on weakening volume. This mean-reversion strategy fades the gap (opposite direction of GAP_AND_GO) by entering on retracement with low volume confirmation, targeting full gap fill or 1.5R.

## Mechanism
Calculate gap = today's open - prior close. If |gap| > 0.5% of prior close and gap is down (open < prior close), then when price reaches a level that has closed 50% of the gap (open + 0.5*gap) on a 5‑min bar with volume < 0.8*average volume of the last 20 bars, go long at the close of that bar. Exit: Stop at the low of the gap bar (chart-stop), target at prior close (full gap fill) or 1.5R whichever is hit first; if not filled by 10:30, exit at market. Regime filters: VIX < 25, time 09:30‑10:30, avoid days with strong pre‑market momentum (|gap| > 1.5% and price continues in gap direction after 5 min).
